notes.title: It's Unreal, really !
notes.notes:
We're excited to share some great news with you: we have officially transitioned to Unreal Engine! This shift marks a significant milestone for us, and as part of this momentous occasion, we have embarked on recreating our first and only level, which we have aptly renamed "The Factory."

In addition to revamping the level, we have also begun implementing multiplayer functionality. Our goal is to create an immersive gaming experience where "Guys" (our in-game characters) can traverse the map together, injecting a vibrant energy into the gameplay.

The anticipation is building, and we can hardly contain our excitement to unveil the new version to our community. We envision a future where Guys are running everywhere, igniting a sense of thrill and camaraderie among players. With your support, we're determined to make this vision a reality. Together, let's embark on this thrilling journey and create something truly remarkable!
